protocol: P0-C stratified green windows, GREEN-SCARCITY terciles (Codex re-ruling 2026-08-23)
supersedes: row-position terciles (k=4/19/34): offset 4036 overlapped the training window by 3164 rows (44%)

stratifier.quantity: mean total power of the five green turbines over the window the episode actually reads
stratifier.why: policy-independent physical measure; row position does not control green scarcity, and scarcity is what determines whether routing has room to matter

training_window.note: training is open-book on a LOW-green window; the three evaluation windows are a cross-scarcity generalisation test, not a claim that k=0 represents the year

applies_to: every arm, every seed, every condition (clean/blend/shuffle)
primary_analysis: pool the three windows first, then seed-level log-ratio; the low-green window alone must not decide seed expansion
secondary_prereg: effect vs green scarcity. If the pooled gate fails but the low-green window is significant, the claim is 'effective under green scarcity', never a year-round advantage
